# CostGraph

> CostGraph finds and cuts cloud and Kubernetes waste. It turns raw spend,
> utilization, and real provider pricing into clear cost visibility, concrete
> rightsizing recommendations, and automatic anomaly detection across
> Kubernetes clusters and cloud virtual machines - with GraphAI, a
> natural-language assistant that answers cost questions from your own data.

CostGraph is a FinOps and cloud cost optimization platform for engineering,
platform, and FinOps teams. It connects to your Kubernetes clusters and cloud
accounts, attributes spend down to namespace, workload, node, pod, persistent
volume, and individual virtual machine, benchmarks it against a maintained
multi-cloud pricing catalog, and shows exactly where you are overpaying. Every
recommendation is concrete and tied to a dollar figure, and cost anomalies are
detected continuously and explained in plain language.

## What CostGraph does

- Cost visibility: spend broken down by cluster, namespace, workload, node, pod,
  persistent volume, and VM, including idle and unallocated cost so Kubernetes
  namespace costs sum to the real node bill.
- Rightsizing recommendations: concrete resize actions for workloads, nodes, and
  VMs, each tied to an estimated monthly saving.
- Anomaly detection: continuous, multi-signal detection of cost spikes, drops,
  step changes, new costly resources, and unit-price changes, with explanations.
- Real provider pricing: a maintained multi-cloud pricing catalog drives
  benchmarks and recommendations instead of list-price guesses.
- GraphAI assistant: ask cost and Kubernetes questions in natural language and
  get answers grounded in your own data, each linked to the exact dashboard page.

## Who it is for

- Platform and infrastructure engineers reducing Kubernetes and compute spend.
- FinOps practitioners attributing and forecasting cloud cost.
- Engineering leaders who want waste surfaced and quantified, not buried.
